---
title: "PLAYING WITH DATA!LOOK AT THIS GRAPH!"
format: html
---

```{r}
world_cup_data <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2022/2022-11-29/worldcups.csv")


library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(world_cup_data, aes(x = year, y = goals_scored)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(world_cup_data, aes(x = year, y = teams)) + 
  geom_line(color = "orange") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(world_cup_data, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = goals_scored), color = "orange") +
  geom_line(aes(y = teams, color = "red")) +
  labs(title = "I PUT THE GRAPHS TOGETHER", x = "YEAR", y = "") 
```
